subject: [192.168.1.31] Storage Pool 1 degraded and was removed from the data scrubbing schedule
snippet: Storage Pool 1 degraded and was removed from the data scrubbing schedule. The storage pool will be added back to the schedule once it has been repaired. From aduki-nas
